newsitem.title: GERMANY: German bank robbers make getaway in helicopter.
newsitem.headline: German bank robbers make getaway in helicopter.

text.p: A gunman robbed a bank of a million marks ($625,000) in Germany on Wednesday -- and escaped by helicopter.
Police said the man made a call with his mobile telephone after the robbery and soon afterwards a helicopter landed on the bank roof.
The bank manager said the robber, who held him up with a machine gun, had made an appointment to see him that afternoon pretending to be a client.
The helicopter was later found abandoned.
A man who identified himself as the pilot told police two men had hired him to take them up and then had forced him to divert the flight.
The robbery took place in the southwestern town of Offenburg, close to the French border.
